text:
Emma: Quick sync — need to lock down the 'audit-ready' data contract and telemetry sample set for the Snowbridge connector marketplace listing. Deadline EOD Wed. Can we confirm fields, retention, PII redaction expectations? cc @Lucy
Tom: Ack. Will owners from eng and legal weigh in?
Sara: From SE side — customers expect sample payloads (parquet/csv) + event schema for telemetry. Proposed columns: request_id, tenant_id (hashed), model_version, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, error_code, timestamp. Nothing PII. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Eng note — hashing tenant_id is fine; we should supply a salt strategy and KMS note. Also include example of query to export last 7 days.
Emma: @Sara can you attach 2 sample files (one parquet, one csv) + a small dataset (20 rows)? We'll include in marketplace docs.
Sara: attaching sample rows below:
```
request_id,tenant_id,model_version,tokens_in,tokens_out,latency_ms,error_code,timestamp
r1,hash_abc,redwood-3b,24,128,135,0,2025-02-12T15:12:01Z
r2,hash_def,redwood-3b,10,64,98,0,2025-02-12T15:13:05Z
r3,hash_ghi,redwood-7b,50,200,210,0,2025-02-12T15:14:10Z
```
Lucy: Legal: retention 90 days by default for telemetry; for enterprise customers we allow configurable retention. Must state that sample datasets are synthetic and contain no production PII. Add clause for data sharing w/ marketplace partner (Snowflake) — need mutual NDA addendum if raw logs are shared. I'll draft.
Tom: Ops: Also call out rate-limited sample download from marketplace — sign-in required.
Alex: FYI, telemetry schema versioning: v1.0 initial. We'll add semantic versioning header in JSON: schema_version: "redwood.telemetry.v1"
deploy-bot: CI check — sample schema passes lint (no PII flags) :robot_face:
Emma: Great. Lucy — can you post the NDA addendum draft by Tue morning? Sara/Alex — please upload sample files and a small README with export commands and the KMS notes.
Sara: I'll upload to the repo at: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-samples/tree/connector-snowbridge-samples
Alex: Adding KMS note: "Use envelope encryption; store salt in KMS; hashed tenant_id must use HMAC-SHA256." Will include snippet:
```
hmac = HMAC_SHA256(salt, tenant_id)
```
Lucy: Draft done — see link (internal doc) — https://internal.redwood/legal/nda-addendum/snowbridge-marketplace — please review.
Emma: Thanks all. Quick checklist: Lucy NDA, Sara sample files + README, Alex KMS snippet, Tom ops download gating. Ping here when done. :eyes:
Sara: Done — samples uploaded, README PR #142
Alex: KMS snippet in PR #143
Lucy: NDA uploaded, marked for 2 reviewers
Emma: Closing loop — I'll assemble final package and send to Snowflake PM. Thanks! :tada:
